extra.description: Additional evidence digests/ids (optional). Supplementary evidence only. This is not a substitute for typed contract fields such as `breakglass_receipt_digests`; richer redacted adapter/runtime material may appear here or in external case attachments until a dedicated typed family exists. When that supplementary material is exported or referenced portably, keep it receipt-first on typed `redaction.receipt` / `export.receipt` / `transport.receipt` evidence digests rather than raw case attachment handles or ticket prose. Supplementary breakglass adapter/runtime material carried here must stay authority-anchored to the same bundle's `breakglass_receipt_digests`; the receipt chain does not prove emergency authority on its own. Portable supplementary breakglass adapter/runtime evidence carried here must stay artifactized: do not use live control locators or entry hints such as console URLs, `ConsoleEntryCommand` values, `WebSocketEndpoint` strings, virtual-media image locators, or session ids/tokens as the archive-facing truth surface. Portable supplementary breakglass adapter/runtime evidence carried here must also stay payload-anchored: keep at least one exported passive artifact digest or accepted case-object proof in the same portable story rather than a receipt-only chain that proves handling happened but never names the artifact/object handled. When the payload anchor uses accepted case-object proof, keep it object-exact on the accepted remote attachment/object/message-part identity; parent ticket/case/thread/container ids may travel as context but not as the sole payload anchor. When the adapter can also see a revision/version/generation/ETag-like validator for that same accepted remote object, keep the payload anchor validator-pinned on that exact visible validator instead of silently drifting across later object revisions. When the adapter can also see a protection/retention/hold posture for that same accepted remote object, keep the payload anchor remote-protection-shaped on that exact visible posture instead of silently upgrading any accepted portal object into durable evidence by implication. Keep that visible protection posture exact to the same accepted object revision/version too; ambient case/container/bucket policy may travel as context only, not as a substitute for object-exact protection proof. When the adapter can also see a redacted/non-secret passive locator for that same accepted remote object revision/version, keep the payload anchor remote-locator-continuous on that same accepted remote locator rather than falling back to parent case/ticket/thread/container browse URLs or portal clicking. Live control locators remain forbidden; broader browse URLs may travel as context only, not as a substitute for object-exact locator continuity. When that same accepted-case-object lane can later metadata-check the same accepted remote object revision/version without re-downloading the body, keep later follow-up on typed `transport.reverification.receipt` evidence instead of screenshots or portal clicking; canonical breakglass follow-up keeps metadata-only reverification with `body_downloaded = false` and preserves the same accepted remote validator / protection posture / locator when visible.

breakglass_receipt_digests.description: Digests of referenced breakglass-receipt objects proving typed emergency-access authority when breakglass participated in the incident. This remains the first-class official handoff proof; richer redacted adapter/runtime detail stays supplementary side evidence on `includes.extra[]` or in external case attachments until a dedicated typed family exists. If that supplementary material travels, keep the portable story receipt-first on typed export/redaction/transport proof rather than raw external handles. Do not let supplementary breakglass adapter/runtime receipt chains travel as orphan portable stories; keep at least one matching `breakglass.receipt` digest in the same bundle or handoff when that richer side evidence travels. Keep live control locators, copied console-entry commands, websocket endpoints, image locators, and session tokens out of the portable bundle story; exported artifacts and typed handling receipts are the portable surface instead. Keep the same portable story payload-anchored too: when richer supplementary breakglass adapter/runtime material travels, carry at least one exported passive artifact digest or accepted case-object proof alongside the handling receipts so later review does not need portal archaeology to recover payload identity. If that same portable story uses accepted case-object proof as the payload anchor, keep it object-exact rather than case-exact: the proof should name the accepted remote attachment/object/message-part identity, not merely the parent ticket/case/thread/container id. And when the adapter can see a revision/version/generation/ETag-like validator for that same accepted remote object, keep the accepted-case-object payload anchor validator-pinned on that exact visible validator rather than letting object-exact drift back into object-latest semantics. And when the adapter can also see a protection/retention/hold posture for that same accepted remote object, keep the accepted-case-object payload anchor remote-protection-shaped on that exact visible posture rather than quietly treating any accepted portal object as durable evidence by implication. Keep that visible protection posture exact to the same accepted object revision/version too; ambient case/container/bucket policy may travel as context only, not as a substitute for object-exact protection proof. And when the adapter can also see a redacted/non-secret passive locator for that same accepted remote object revision/version, keep the accepted-case-object payload anchor remote-locator-continuous on that same accepted remote locator rather than falling back to parent case/ticket/thread/container browse URLs or portal clicking. Live control locators remain forbidden; broader browse URLs may travel as context only, not as a substitute for object-exact locator continuity. When that same accepted-case-object lane can later metadata-check the same accepted remote object revision/version without re-downloading the body, keep later follow-up on typed `transport.reverification.receipt` evidence instead of screenshots or portal clicking; canonical breakglass follow-up keeps metadata-only reverification with `body_downloaded = false` and preserves the same accepted remote validator / protection posture / locator when visible.
